company.name: Urban Company
company.shortDescription: Urban Company provides home cleaning, maintenance, and beauty treatment services conveniently delivered to the doorstep.
company.description: Urban provides a marketplace for freelance labor. It offers a variety of home services to consumers, including beauty treatments, haircuts, deep cleaning, plumbing, carpentry, and appliance repairs. The platform helps customers book reliable home services and it aims to help millions of service professionals across the world to deliver services at home. The company partners with tens of thousands of service professionals, helping them with training, credit, product procurement, insurance, and technology.

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Post IPO Secondary round raised $44,860,312, or 7.22% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.
caveats: Crunchbase reports 15 rounds but provides 10 detailed rows.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $480,000,000 to $201,126,901,033, a 419.01x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.
